# IStargateReceiver
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/chain-bridge/src/interfaces/IStargateReceiver.sol)

**Title:**
IStargateReceiver

Interface for receiving cross-chain messages through Stargate


## Functions
### sgReceive

Called by Stargate router when tokens are received from another chain


```solidity
function sgReceive(
    uint16 _chainId,
    bytes memory _srcAddress,
    uint256 _nonce,
    address _token,
    uint256 _amount,
    bytes memory _payload
)
    external;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`_chainId`|`uint16`|Source chain ID in Stargate format|
|`_srcAddress`|`bytes`|Source address as bytes|
|`_nonce`|`uint256`|Stargate nonce|
|`_token`|`address`|Address of the token being transferred|
|`_amount`|`uint256`|Amount of tokens received|
|`_payload`|`bytes`|ABI encoded payload sent from source chain|
